zh-CN:
更新内容
• 新增「升频」音效：补全高频并升采样，适用于 ≤48 kHz 单/双声道 PCM；可在「设置 → 音效」中设置应用范围（仅有损歌曲 / 有损及 ≤48 kHz 无损歌曲），默认关闭，仅在 DSP 总开关开启时生效
• 设置页新增桌面歌词模式切换，可直接在悬浮窗口与任务栏之间切换
• 任务栏歌词：点击音量图标即可静音
• 修复长时间播放时封面资源持续增长导致的内存上涨
• 修复低采样率音频重采样时可能出现的帧丢失
• 修复快速切歌时旧会话资源未及时释放，以及 ASIO 输出初始化或回调超时后资源无法安全释放的问题
• 移除「隐藏窗口时释放内存」「播放后自动释放内存」「立即释放内存」设置：相关系统接口并不会真正释放内存
en:
Release Notes
• New Upsampling effect: restores high frequencies and upsamples mono/stereo PCM up to 48 kHz; choose its scope in Settings → Audio effects (lossy songs only / lossy + lossless up to 48 kHz), off by default and active only when DSP is enabled
• The settings page adds a Desktop Lyrics Mode switch between the floating window and the taskbar
• Taskbar lyrics: click the volume icon to mute
• Fixed cover resources and memory growing continuously during long playback
• Fixed frame loss that could occur when resampling low-sample-rate audio
• Fixed previous playback session resources not being released in time when switching tracks quickly, and ASIO output not releasing resources safely after initialization or callback timeouts
• Removed the ineffective memory-release settings (Release memory when hiding window / Auto-release memory after playback / Release memory now): the underlying system APIs do not actually free private memory
